hook: Let's carve a bear. One knife.
lines: Let's carve a little bear out of basswood together.
Basswood is soft, so beginners can shape it with one knife.
Start with the head, then round the ears with small cuts.
Find the bear kit at beavercrafttools.com and carve along.

why: Серія «One knife, one animal». Формула «вирізаємо тварину з липи одним ножем» — ведмедик у Werewolf зібрав 1,3 млн. Мета: видимий результат за хвилину і перехід на набір «Bear».
rules: Show BeaverCraft products (kits, knives, finished figures) in the first seconds. Wood carving only — no other crafts (no straw, weaving, painting). No text over faces.
